This '''individual''' lived in the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. They met the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Finn (Sith)|Finn]] and his [[Finn's Sith apprentice|apprentice]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Finn)|planet]] for business in a building. After concluding business with the individual, Finn and his apprentice exited the building and detonated the bomb they had placed in the structure.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This individual first appeared in the short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[The Apprentice (comic story)|The Apprentice]]," which was featured in [[Star Wars Tales 17|''Star Wars Tales'' 17]] and written by [[Mike Denning]]. The story was later compiled into a [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] version and republished in ''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 5]]''. Plausible stories in [[Star Wars Tales 1|''Star Wars Tales'' 1]]&ndash;''[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]]'' were initially viewed as [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM|quote=Consider everything that's not completely outrageous or intentionally comic as S-canon. If it's referenced in another non-Tales source, then elevate it to C-canon.}}</ref> Because the subject material of the comic was mentioned in Finn's, Marka's, and Lod's entries in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> this elevates the character's appearance in ''The Apprentice'' to C-canon.
